package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

func (store Store) ResolveExact(ctx context.Context, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetRef, error) {
	types := make([]string, len(targets))
	keys := make([]string, len(targets))
	versions := make([]string, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		types[index] = string(target.Type)
		keys[index] = target.Key
		versions[index] = target.Version
	}
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT target.target_type, target.target_key, target.target_version
FROM learning_target target
JOIN unnest($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::text[]) AS requested(target_type, target_key, target_version)
  ON target.target_type=requested.target_type
 AND target.target_key=requested.target_key
 AND target.target_version=requested.target_version`, types, keys, versions)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]domain.TargetRef, 0, len(targets))
	for rows.Next() {
		var target domain.TargetRef
		if err := rows.Scan(&target.Type, &target.Key, &target.Version); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, target)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (store Store) DiscoverByStacks(ctx context.Context, stacks []string, limit int) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error) {
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT DISTINCT target.target_type, target.target_key, target.target_version
FROM learning_target target
LEFT JOIN learning_target_stack stack
  ON stack.target_type=target.target_type
 AND stack.target_key=target.target_key
 AND stack.target_version=target.target_version
WHERE cardinality($1::text[])=0 OR stack.stack_code=ANY($1::text[])
ORDER BY target.target_type, target.target_key, target.target_version
LIMIT $2`, stacks, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	refs := make([]domain.TargetRef, 0, limit)
	for rows.Next() {
		var ref domain.TargetRef
		if err := rows.Scan(&ref.Type, &ref.Key, &ref.Version); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		refs = append(refs, ref)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil || len(refs) == 0 {
		return nil, err
	}
	return store.ResolveDefinitions(ctx, refs)
}

func (store Store) ResolveDefinitions(ctx context.Context, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error) {
	types := make([]string, len(targets))
	keys := make([]string, len(targets))
	versions := make([]string, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		types[index], keys[index], versions[index] = string(target.Type), target.Key, target.Version
	}
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT requested.ordinality, target.target_type, target.target_key, target.target_version,
       target.title, target.description,
       prerequisite.prerequisite_type, prerequisite.prerequisite_key, prerequisite.prerequisite_version
FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY
     AS requested(target_type, target_key, target_version, ordinality)
JOIN learning_target target
  ON target.target_type=requested.target_type
 AND target.target_key=requested.target_key
 AND target.target_version=requested.target_version
LEFT JOIN target_prerequisite prerequisite
  ON prerequisite.target_type=target.target_type
 AND prerequisite.target_key=target.target_key
 AND prerequisite.target_version=target.target_version
ORDER BY requested.ordinality, prerequisite.prerequisite_type,
         prerequisite.prerequisite_key, prerequisite.prerequisite_version`, types, keys, versions)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, 0, len(targets))
	byIdentity := make(map[string]int, len(targets))
	for rows.Next() {
		var ordinal int64
		var definition domain.LearningTargetDefinition
		var prerequisiteType, prerequisiteKey, prerequisiteVersion *string
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&ordinal, &definition.Ref.Type, &definition.Ref.Key, &definition.Ref.Version,
			&definition.Title, &definition.Description,
			&prerequisiteType, &prerequisiteKey, &prerequisiteVersion,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		identity := domain.TargetIdentity(definition.Ref)
		index, exists := byIdentity[identity]
		if !exists {
			index = len(result)
			byIdentity[identity] = index
			result = append(result, definition)
		}
		if prerequisiteType != nil && prerequisiteKey != nil && prerequisiteVersion != nil {
			result[index].Prerequisites = append(result[index].Prerequisites, domain.TargetRef{
				Type: domain.TargetType(*prerequisiteType), Key: *prerequisiteKey, Version: *prerequisiteVersion,
			})
		}
		_ = ordinal
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

var _ repository.TargetCatalog = Store{}
var _ repository.TargetDiscoveryCatalog = Store{}
var _ repository.PracticeLearningCatalog = Store{}
